name: version-range-input
title: Version Range Input
description: npm-style semver range input that reads ranges back in plain English, marks which published versions match and which installs, and warns about ^0.x lock-in, a hyphen without spaces, commas used for AND and ranges that match nothing.

meta.stops: Semver range installs the wrong version
meta.summary: Reads npm semver ranges back in plain English and shows which published versions match and which one installs.
catches: Ranges that match no published version
^0.x and ^0.0.x, which lock to a minor or patch
Commas used where npm expects spaces (AND)
Latest version falling outside the range
limits: Implements node-semver default options; includePrerelease and loose modes are not modelled
Needs the published versions list you pass
a11y: Visible <label>; aria-invalid with hint via aria-describedby
Hint in a polite live region; parse errors use role=alert
Versions list has an aria-label; each row states matches/does not match in text
